description: Permissions for the main window (v0.18.3): the app's own commands its interface calls (the main-window set in permissions/windows.toml), core features, the system open-file dialog (to choose a Bible or template to import) and save dialog (to choose where an export is saved), the updater (checking for and installing a signed update; only active in builds that configure it) and opening an http(s) link, on the person's explicit click, in the default browser.
